# `funding_conversion_bill`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

Immutable bill set consuming one command hold atomically; legacy single-bill conversions retain their original target.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `customer_bill_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Independently settled purchase bill, owned by exactly one conversion. |
| `hold_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Command hold whose exact sources fund this bill. |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Shared owner of hold and bill, serialized by account lock. |
